findings.title: Envelope-to-status mapping re-implemented a third time
findings.detail: Copies the private respond() at src/libs/api/route-handler.ts:19-21 (also at src/app/api/cron/reminders/route.ts:55). Acceptable under the hard rule forbidding route-handler.ts edits; follow-up: export respond.

findings.title: Availability test covers only the success case
findings.detail: Add a case where get resolves { success: false } and assert status 400.

findings.title: Input validation: public availability GET forwards every query param unchecked
findings.detail: forwardQuery: true sends Object.fromEntries(searchParams) (route-handler.ts:37) so any anonymous caller can send any parameter upstream to the endpoint B-006 covers, and date/doctorId are never format-checked (B-001). Fix: read only doctorId and date, validate with zod, 400 on failure, call apiServer.get directly.

findings.title: Authz: the receptionist gate trusts a role claim clients can forge (pre-existing bug)
findings.detail: `if (trigger === 'update' && session) return { ...token, ...session }` copies client-sent session data into the JWT; a signed-in non-receptionist can set roles ['receptionist'] and pass isReceptionist() at appointments/route.ts:38-43. Fix outside this unit: allow only harmless fields in the update path; until then the upstream must enforce its own receptionist check.

findings.title: CSRF: cookie-authorized state-changing POST has no Origin check
findings.detail: Reject mismatched Origin and require content-type application/json before parsing.
